name: item.alchemical-bomb.name
editNote: Accepted: the book's own Martial Weapons table (p.281) prints Alchemical Bomb's Price AND Damage both as 'Varies' with a footnote -- this table row is a generic category placeholder for the whole family of thrown alchemical bombs (Acid Flask, Alchemist's Fire, etc.), each with its own concrete stats detailed elsewhere; there is no single number to record here even in the book. Leaving damage/price unset matches the book's own placeholder rather than inventing values. Critical Specialization Effects (bomb group) is the same recorded per-group omission accepted for other weapons.
